answer: Split-tally bond stops mass fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credits and splits its tally in two: half goes to the harbor ledger, a whisper sends the sealed half to an auditor. A gale audit replays one in twenty; mismatch, copy, or borrowed tally burns the bond. First tally 44, k-th 44+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,041,000 for a 40,000 pool. Rented halves fail: only the auditor holds the match. Honest agents pay 44 once and keep their share.
